<!-- EMBED THIS AT THE VERY BOTTOM OF YOUR FILE -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.pdf-col').forEach(col => {
    const url = col.getAttribute('data-src');
    const title = col.querySelector('h3').innerText;

    fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' })
      .then(res => {
        if (res.ok) {
          // File exists: Inject the interactive PDF frame and footer navigation
          col.innerHTML = `
            <h3>${title}</h3>
            <object data="${url}#toolbar=0" type="application/pdf" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover;"></object>
            <p>Scroll to view | <a href="${url}">Download</a></p>
          `;
        } else {
          // File missing: Replace EVERYTHING below the header with just the "No slides." message
          col.innerHTML = `
            <h3>${title}</h3>
            <div style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fdfdfd; border: 1px dashed #ccc; color: #777;">
              <span><b>No slides.</b></span>
            </div>
          `;
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  });
});
</script>
